name: ak:issue-to-plan
overview: Turn a GitHub issue into an audited, validated implementation plan. Reads the issue, scouts the codebase, runs a hard brainstorm gate, and only then plans with mandatory --html --wiki, validate, and red-team, before pushing a plan branch and handing off on the issue. Use to convert a GitHub issue into a validated plan that is ready for plan audit.
whenToUse: Invoke when a user wants one command to take a GitHub issue through scouting, an audit/brainstorm gate, and (only if it passes) plan generation, validation, red-team, a pushed plan branch, and an issue handoff — stopping before implementation.
